links.comparator_used: GenAI used as a primary decision-making tool (AI-led) in the vignette; a no-GenAI control vignette was also included
links.outcome: Peer clinicians' rating of the depicted physician's clinical skill (1-7 scale)
links.effect: GenAI-verify mean 4.99 vs GenAI-primary mean 3.79; no-GenAI Control 5.93 (p < 0.001 for the reported contrasts)
links.tradeoff: Verification framing only partially mitigated the penalty. Peers still rated the physician lower than in the no-GenAI Control, and similar patterns appeared for perceived overall healthcare experience and competence.
links.quote: Framing GenAI use as verification partially mitigated this effect (4.99, p < 0.001).

design_hint: framing GenAI as verification tool rather than primary decision aid
